title: Law to create a committee reviewing city labor bargaining practices
summary: This bill would establish a citywide collective bargaining assessment committee made up of city officials, a labor expert and a union representative to evaluate how the City negotiates contracts for its lowest-paid employees. Each year by January 1 the committee would review wages and job conditions for the lowest-paid quarter of the municipal workforce, and by April 30 issue public recommendations for at least three job titles. The law would take effect 60 days after becoming law.
